recommendation: Keep this audit commit as-is. Validator trigger work should use the value sets currently bound to Observation.code and Observation.component.code. Do not restore observation-vitalsign-category in core unless a future WG decision reverses the category-vs-code direction.
issue_request: FHIR-51480 asked that vital-signs profile category validation rely on defined value sets rather than a validator-specific GitHub file; the Applied/Persuasive resolution says, "The value set is on the core profile."
initial_application: No source commit explicitly mentioned FHIR-51480. The nearest pre-application trail was 0a17c0f40f, which added a then-current Observation.category binding to observation-vitalsign-category and added observation-vitalsign-measurement value-set bindings used by the Vital Signs Base profile.
additional_context: FHIR-45617 and FHIR-50689 later rejected moving vital-signs identification from Observation.code to Observation.category, and 66a80b5fef removed observation-vitalsign-category while preserving the code-based bindings. FHIR-50452 and the 2025-10-10 OO minutes confirm that the interoperability standard code no longer is the category.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current combined branch has the applicable value-set references on Observation.code and component code, keeps the required vital-signs category slice, and relies on the base Observation.category binding for the general category value set.
